title: KCP deployment_drain request (DESIGN.md §10.5, §11.6.1 assistant author/deploy family)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2: every state-changing operation requires meta). Stops new invocations selecting this deployment while existing invocations finish; the resulting status token mirrors the design-wide draining vocabulary (§10.9, §9.5), the deployment machine itself being unpinned (gap notes KG6/KG11). Registry (developer_assistant_v1): surface operator / principal (assurance: current login). Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible (gap note KG14 for dual-surface ops).

args.description: Target only; the exact deployment revision is pinned by meta.expected_revision (gap note KG11).

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
